localChanges: Took getMediaSource and isManagedMediaSource from mediasource-helper.ts; removeSourceChildren and addSource from buffer-controller.ts. Nothing else is copied.
Strict TypeScript: explicit types, `self` replaced by `globalThis` so the module stays Worker/SSR safe.
addSource takes the MIME type as a parameter (default video/mp4) and returns the element; uses media.ownerDocument instead of self.document.
removeSourceChildren iterates with Array.from instead of [].slice.call.
